{{Top|leg}}
An '''equipment sled''' was used to transport items. The interior space of an equipment sled was large enough for a [[Sluissi]] to fit inside, and could be sealed to [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] used an equipment sled to transport [[Hass Sonax]] from an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] to the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Asaari Wind]]'' when they had to board it undetected.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
